hookText: Why does this bezel only turn one way?

scenes.text: Why does this bezel only turn one way?
scenes.subject: an unbranded brushed-steel dive watch with a matte black bezel and white triangle at twelve
scenes.setting: on a charcoal watchmaker mat, crown on the right
scenes.lighting: soft cool light from the left with a narrow silver rim
scenes.action: a gloved fingertip nudges the knurled bezel counterclockwise by one click while the watch stays fixed

scenes.text: Before a dive, line up the triangle with the minute hand.
scenes.subject: the same brushed-steel dive watch, matte black bezel, white triangle and fixed minute hand
scenes.setting: on the same charcoal watchmaker mat, crown on the right
scenes.lighting: soft cool light from the left with a narrow silver rim
scenes.action: the outer bezel rotates counterclockwise until the triangle aligns with the minute hand

scenes.text: As the minute hand moves, read elapsed time against the bezel.
scenes.subject: the same watch dial and bezel, with the minute hand pointing to the bezel scale
scenes.setting: on the same charcoal watchmaker mat, crown on the right
scenes.lighting: soft cool light from the left with a narrow silver rim
scenes.action: a fingertip points to the bezel mark directly beside the minute hand without moving the watch

scenes.text: If you bump it, that one-way click makes the dive look longer.
scenes.subject: the same brushed-steel watch and black bezel next to a single gloved fingertip
scenes.setting: on the same charcoal watchmaker mat, crown on the right
scenes.lighting: soft cool light from the left with a narrow silver rim
scenes.action: the fingertip bumps the bezel one click counterclockwise while the minute hand stays fixed

scenes.text: That little click gives you a reason to surface sooner.
scenes.subject: the same unbranded steel dive watch, with the bezel triangle offset from the minute hand
scenes.setting: on the same charcoal watchmaker mat, crown on the right
scenes.lighting: soft cool light from the left with a narrow silver rim
scenes.action: the fingertip withdraws and the watch holds still in the final position
